listed_quote.quote: Ares Capital Corporation (NASDAQ: ARCC) and Allied Capital Corporation (NYSE: ALD) announced today that they have entered into a definitive agreement

announcement.quote: have entered into a definitive agreement under which Ares Capital will acquire Allied Capital in an all stock transaction currently valued at $648 million, or approximately $3.47 per Allied Capital share.

deals.notes: Allied stockholders approved the merger on 2010-03-26 (8-K 0001299933-10-001288) and closing was anticipated on or around April 1, 2010, but no excerpted filing states the merger was completed (the 2010-04-01 8-K is shown only as its first 800 characters). A competing Prospect Capital proposal was rejected by the Allied board and Prospect terminated its solicitation on 2010-03-05. No failure is stated.
